notes.title: New Patch: Bug and QoL Fixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Howdy y'all![/h1]

Today, we've released a patch that fixes some minor bugs and makes a few quality of life improvements. We hope this makes your space western adventure even better. 

[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed feuds that displayed incorrectly in the campaign after a challenge
[*] Fixed Carnivore + Ace not working correctly
[*] You can now break out of aim toggle when you start sprinting
[*] Performance improvements to Sarge's Info Hud
[*] Challenge 13 various fixes
[*] More Spawn points for allies on moon maps
[*] Made sure all items drop, and that Collector achievement only requires 128 items.
[/list]

TECHNICAL SUPPORT:

If you experience any technical issues, please reach out via the [url=https://discord.com/invite/bluemanchuofficial]Blue Manchu Discord[/url] or in the Steam forums. We'll be checking both.

Thank you so much for supporting us along the way to this moment!

[h1]Until next time gunslinger![/h1]
